principles: Institutional financial databases are not treated like ordinary media or web pages.
Institutional database QA emphasizes schema, dates, units, entity identifiers, logic checks, anomaly flags, license/storage boundary, coverage and freshness.
Coverage limitations are normal and do not make an institutional database untrusted as a platform.
Media/news/community sources can provide event, sentiment, or clue candidates, but key facts require cross-source fact checks.
Anomalies are retained with flags rather than silently deleted.
Formal trusted consumption remains unchanged until a separate production switch exists.

candidate_state_policy.institutional_high_confidence_candidate: Institutional database source with QA-passing schema/logic and clear source identifiers; coverage/freshness/license may still be limited.
candidate_state_policy.licensed_high_confidence_candidate: Licensed institutional source such as Morningstar with entitlement/manual token control and no automatic login.
candidate_state_policy.production_candidate: Automated pipeline can store and update data as candidate/staging evidence after QA; not formal trusted consumption.
candidate_state_policy.coverage_limited_but_usable: Dataset may not cover all entities, but observed coverage is still usable and should be labeled.
candidate_state_policy.freshness_limited_but_usable: Dataset has useful historical or identifier value even if latest updates lag or freshness cadence is limited.
candidate_state_policy.media_event_candidate: Media/news event or sentiment item, never an institutional data fact by itself.
candidate_state_policy.needs_cross_source_fact_check: Ordinary media/community source fact needs validation before research factual use.
candidate_state_policy.anomaly_flagged_candidate: Data kept with anomaly flags and review notes.
candidate_state_policy.institutional_proxy_high_confidence_cand: Interface-level wrapper/proxy data whose upstream provenance is a mature institutional market data, exchange, or official source; requires stable endpoint, QA pass, clear entity mapping, and field-level provenance.
candidate_state_policy.trusted_candidate: For official, institutional, licensed institutional, or institutional proxy source lines, trusted_candidate can be assigned at dataset/field level when provenance is explicit, QA passes, entity mapping is clear, and logic checks pass. Coverage need not be 100%.

required_evidence: field-level completeness or explicit field limitation
